items.t: Rocket Companies Appoints Datadog COO Adam Blitzer to Board of Directors
items.sum: Rocket Companies (NYSE: RKT), the Detroit-based homeownership platform, today announced the appointment of Adam Blitzer, Chief Operating Officer of Datadog, as an independent director to its Board of Directors.

items.t: Is It Worth Investing in Datadog (DDOG) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.sum: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Datadog (DDOG) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.t: Down 37% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why Datadog (DDOG) Looks Ripe for a Turnaround
items.sum: The heavy selling pressure might have exhausted for Datadog (DDOG) as it is technically in oversold territory now. In addition to this technical measure, strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher indicates that the stock is ripe for a trend reversal.

items.t: Datadog vs. Fastly: Which Cloud Tech Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
items.sum: Datadog's revenue grew nearly 28% in FY 2025, while Fastly still posted a net loss, but one valuation gap may matter more than either growth or losses.
